title: X-to-Y comparison master row
description: One experiments_master.csv row represents one paper x experiment x X-to-Y comparison. Unaware capacity and awareness effect are independent inference axes. JSON arrays are encoded in their CSV cells.

awareness_result_reporting.description: Whether a critical awareness result is actually reported for the focal experiment; a described procedure is not a result.

awareness_result_support.description: Whether the reported critical awareness result supports the stated strong-A classification; kept separate from result availability.

Y_functional_status.description: Explicit semantic audit of whether focal Y names a downstream function/mapping rather than merely an observed effect.

difference_tested.description: Whether a direct aware/unaware difference or interaction on this same focal Y was tested; this is recorded independently of E strength.

promotion_challenge.description: Source-linked checks made before a strong A, meaningful F, diagnostic E, or whole-Y capacity claim is finalized.

unaware_capacity_regime_keys.description: Explicit regime keys to which the assessed whole-Y unaware-capacity claim applies; never inferred from lower-awareness labels.
